home.title: Dementia & Alzheimer's Games and Activities | Golden Moments
home.description: Imidlalo yasimahla nethambileyo yemifanekiso yokudlala kwi-intanethi neengcamango zemisebenzi yabantu abaphila nedementia okanye i-Alzheimer's nabanonopheli babo. Akukho kubhalisa, ziwotshi okanye manqaku.
home.eyebrow: Simahla · Akukho zintengiso · Akukho kubhalisa · Akukho ziwotshi okanye manqaku
home.h1: Gentle Games & Activities for People with Dementia
home.lede: Imidlalo elula yemifanekiso, iifoto eziqhelekileyo, nemisebenzi yokonwabela kunye—ngesantya senu.
facts: Yima nanini na; akukho nto yakufeyila
home.heroApp: Kukwakho ne-aphu yasimahla ye-iPhone, i-iPad ne-Android, enokusebenzisa iifoto zentsapho yakho
home.gamesLede: Umdlalo ngamnye uzolile, wenzelwe abantu abadala kwaye uqala msinya. Khethani omnye, hlalanani ecaleni, nize nitshintshiselane ngokucofa.

steps.title: Khetha into eqhelekileyo
steps.text: Imifanekiso yeekomityi zeti, izitiya, izilwanyana zasekhaya nezikhephe. Akukho kufunda okanye mithetho ekufuneka iqale yafundwa.

steps.title: Hlalani ecaleni komnye nomnye
steps.text: Bavumele bacofe. Thethani ngemifanekiso. Xa imifanekiso ingangqinelani, ilinda nje ucofo olulandelayo.

steps.title: Yimani kusenolonwabo
steps.text: Umdlalo omnye ngumsebenzi opheleleyo. Igama elithi “Kwanele okwangoku” lihlala likwisikrini.

home.stageLede: Umculo, imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla, ukukhumbula izinto zakudala namaxesha azolileyo ovakalelo, elungiselelwe oko kukhululekileyo ngoku.

stages.title: Inqanaba lokuqala
stages.text: Qhubekani nokwenza izinto abazithandayo, nenze utshintsho oluncinci: izinto zokuzonwabisa, ukuhambahamba, imidlalo yamagama nokucwangcisa kunye.
stages.label: Iingcamango zenqanaba lokuqala

stages.title: Inqanaba eliphakathi
stages.text: Imisebenzi elula neqhelekileyo eyahlulwe ngokwamanyathelo: ukusonga, ukuhlela, umculo, imidlalo yemifanekiso nokuhambahamba okufutshane.
stages.label: Iingcamango zenqanaba eliphakathi

stages.title: Inqanaba lamva
stages.text: Intuthuzelo nobudlelwane ngokuchukumisa, isandi nokubona: ukunyamekela izandla, iingoma ezithandwayo, iifoto nokuba kunye.
stages.label: Iingcamango zenqanaba lamva

home.specificHtml: Ingaba ukhangela into ethile? Zama imisebenzi nemidlalo ye-Alzheimer's, imidlalo ethambileyo yenkumbulo, imibuzo elula yolwazi okanye iiphazili.
home.approachLede: Imidlalo emininzi “yokuqeqesha ingqondo” yakhelwe phezu kwesantya, amanqaku nokuphumelela ngokulandelelana. Kumntu ophila nedementia oko kunokuvakala njengoviwo. Thina sakhe eyahluke ngokupheleleyo.

principles.title: Akukho nto yakufeyila
principles.text: Akukho wotshi, manqaku, bomi okanye ukoyisakala. Umfanekiso owahlukileyo sisinqumamo nje, ayingompazamo.

principles.title: Imifanekiso ihlala ibonakala
principles.text: Ukubona into oyaziyo endaweni yokuzama ukuyikhumbula. Ukutshatisa kuqala ivulekile imifanekiso, ngoko akukho nto ekufuneka uyikhumbule.

principles.title: Yenzelwe abantu abadala kwaye inesidima
principles.text: Amagama afudumeleyo naziwayo nemifanekiso yobomi bokwenyani. Azize zibe ziikhathuni okanye intetho yabantwana.

principles.title: Ikhuselekile ngokwendalo
principles.text: Akukho zii-akhawunti okanye zintengiso. Iifoto zakho aziphumi kwisixhobo sakho.

guides.title: Indlela yokudlala imidlalo kunye
guides.text: Ukulungiselela, isantya, nento onokuyenza xa umdlalo ungasemnandanga.

guides.title: Xa besala ukwenza umsebenzi
guides.text: Izizathu eziqhelekileyo zokwala, neendlela ezithambileyo zokuzama kwakhona kamva.

guides.title: Ukulungiselela ithebhulethi
guides.text: Amagama amakhulu, iziphazamiso ezimbalwa nesikrini sasekhaya esinye nesilula.

guides.title: Imisebenzi yasimahla enokushicilelwa
guides.text: Imidlalo yamagama abhalwe ngobukhulu, amaphepha okufaka imibala, ibingo namakhadi eencoko.

home.researchText: Ingaba idementia inokuthintelwa na? Ingaba imidlalo yengqondo iyanceda? Kuthekani ngokuzila ukutya, ukutya okunempilo, ubuthongo nokuva? Iimpendulo ezicacileyo nezineembekiselo, kuquka nalapho ubungqina bungaqinisekanga khona.
home.appText: I-aphu yasimahla isebenza ngaphandle kwe-intanethi kwaye inokusebenzisa iifoto zentsapho ozikhethileyo, ezigcinwa njengeekopi kwisixhobo sakho. Uyilo oluzolileyo olufanayo: iithayile ezine ezinkulu, akukho wotshi, akukho manqaku.

faq.q: Yeyiphi imidlalo elungileyo yabantu abaphila nedementia?
faq.a: Imidlalo elungileyo ilula, iqhelekile kwaye ayinabunzima okanye uxinzelelo: imifanekiso emikhulu yokutshatisa, ukuhlela, iiphazili ezilula, ukugqibezela izaci ezaziwayo, ukufaka imibala, ibhingo yemifanekiso namakhadi eencoko. Eyona ilungileyo yileyo umntu ayonwabelayo namhlanje. Kuphepha iiwotshi ezibala ixesha, amanqaku nayo nantoni na evakala ngathi luvavanyo.

Ewe. Yonke imidlalo nezinto eziprintwayo kwi-Golden Moments zisimahla, ngaphandle kweakhaunti, ukubhalisa okanye ukukhuphela. Imidlalo isebenza kwisikhangeli sewebhu kwifowuni, kwithebhulethi okanye kwikhompyutha.

Akukho mdlalo uboniswe ukuba uyayithintela idementia, kwaye i-Golden Moments ayitsho ukuba inyanga okanye ithintela nantoni na. Imidlalo yethu yeyokuzonwabisa nokuba kunye. Icandelo lethu lempilo yobuchopho licacisa oko kuboniswa noko kungabonakaliyo kuphando.

faq.q: Ingaba le midlalo imfanele umntu one-Alzheimer's?
faq.a: Ewe. Isifo se-Alzheimer sesona sizathu sixhaphakileyo sedementia, kwaye le midlalo yenzelwe yona: imifanekiso emikhulu ehlala ibonakala, ukhetho oluncinci, kwaye akukho nto ekufuneka uyikhumbule okanye uphazame kuyo. Ukutshatisa, ukuhlela nokugqibezela izaci eziqhelekileyo kuxhomekeke kulwazi oselukho kunesakhono esitsha sokufunda.

faq.q: Ingaba umntu okumanqanaba asemva edementia angayisebenzisa le misebenzi?
faq.a: Amaxesha amaninzi, ewe, xa enomntu osecaleni kwakhe. Qala nge-Fumana efanayo enemifanekiso emibini, Izibini zemifanekiso ezinamakhadi amane, iphepha lokufaka imibala okanye ukunqumama ngokuzolileyo uphefumle. Yenze ibe mfutshane, landela indlela abavakalelwa ngayo uze uyeke xa bebanelisekile.

Le sayithi ayinazo ii-akhaunti kwaye ayinantengiso. Sisebenzisa i-Google Analytics ukuqonda ukuba ngawaphi amaphepha atyelelwayo. Iifoto ozikhethela Izibini zeefoto zibonakala kuphela kwisikhangeli sakho kwaye azize zilayishwe ndawo.

I-Golden Moments liqela elincinci elenza imisebenzi yemifanekiso ezolileyo yabantu abadala elungiselelwe iintsapho nabakhathaleli, kwiwebhu nanjenge-app yasimahla. Asingogqirha, kwaye akukho nto apha elicebiso lezonyango.

playCta.title: Ingaba ulungele umdlalo ozolileyo?
playCta.text: Imifanekiso emikhulu, akukho wotshi ibala ixesha, akukho manqaku kwaye akukho kubhalisa. Dlalani kunye kwisikhangeli sakho.

appCta.title: Hamba nale midlalo nawe
appCta.text: I-app yasimahla ye-Golden Moments ye-iPhone, iPad ne-Android: iithayile zemifanekiso emikhulu, imidlalo eneefoto zentsapho yakho, neepakethi zemifanekiso ezisebenza ngaphandle kwe-Wi‑Fi. Ayinakhaunti, azikho iintengiso, iwotshi ebala ixesha okanye amanqaku.

activities.description: Izimvo zemisebenzi yabantu abaphila nedementia kuwo onke amanqanaba: umculo, ukukhumbula izinto zangaphambili, imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla, amaxesha okuva ngezivamvo, imisebenzi yezandla, phandle nezinto zokuprinta zasimahla.
activities.lede: Umsebenzi onentsingiselo yiyo nantoni na ezisa intuthuzelo, injongo okanye umzuzu wonxibelelwano. Qala ngento umntu ebehlala eyonwabela, uze uyilungelelanise nanamhlanje.

caregiving.label: Ukunakekela
caregiving.title: Izikhokelo Zokunakekela
caregiving.seo: Izikhokelo Zokunakekela Abaphila neDementia: Uncedo Olululo Lwemihla Ngemihla
caregiving.description: Izikhokelo eziluncedo nezobubele zabakhathaleli babantu abaphila nedementia: ukudlala imidlalo kunye, unxibelelwano, ukwala, ukungaphumli ngokuhlwa, iithebhulethi, ukukhetha ii-app nokuzikhathalela wena.
caregiving.lede: Uncedo olucacileyo nolululo kumaxesha emihla ngemihla okunakekela umntu ophila nedementia, kuquka nokuzikhathalela wena.

brain-health.title: Impilo yoBuchopho: Oko Kuthethwa Luphando
brain-health.seo: Impilo yoBuchopho noMngcipheko weDementia: Oko Kuthethwa Luphando
brain-health.description: Ingaba idementia inokuthintelwa? Izikhokelo ezinyanisekileyo nezinemithombo malunga nemingcipheko yedementia, imidlalo yobuchopho, ukuzila ukutya, ukutya, ukwenza umthambo, ubuthongo, ukuva neempawu zokuqala ezilumkisayo.
brain-health.lede: Oko izifundo ezinkulu zikubonisa ngenene malunga nokunciphisa umngcipheko wedementia, kucaciswe ngokulula, kuquka nalapho ubungqina bubuthathaka okanye buxubeneyo. Lulwazi ngokubanzi, asilocebiso lezonyango.

guide.sourcesNote: Sinika amakhonkco emibutho nophononongo eli phepha elixhomekeke kulo. Inye nganye yatshekishwa xa iphepha lalihlaziywa.

healthNotice.title: Lulwazi ngokubanzi, asilocebiso lezonyango
healthNotice.textHtml: Eli phepha lishwankathela uphando olupapashiweyo lweentsapho. Alinakukuxelela okulungele umntu omnye. Thetha nogqirha phambi kokutshintsha ukutya, ukwenza umthambo, ubuthongo, amayeza okanye izongezo zezondlo. Ukuba kukho ukudideka ngesiquphe okanye olunye utshintsho olukhawulezileyo, fumana uncedo lwezonyango ngoko nangoko. Funda isaziso sethu senkcukacha zempilo.

about.title: Umsebenzi Wokwabelana, Asiluvavanyo Lwenkumbulo
about.seoTitle: Malunga ne-Golden Moments: Indlela Yethu Yokusebenza
about.description: Kutheni imidlalo ye-Golden Moments ingenazo iiwotshi ezibala ixesha, amanqaku okanye amanqaku alandelelanayo, kutheni imifanekiso ihlala ibonakala, noko siza kukubanga nesingayi kukubanga ngedementia.
about.lede: I-Golden Moments yenza imisebenzi yemifanekiso ezolileyo yabantu abadala enokonwatyelwa ngumkhathaleli nomntu ophila nedementia bekunye ecaleni.
about.bodyHtml:
Izinto esikholelwa kuzo

Eyona njongo yomsebenzi ngala mzuzu wenziwa ngawo: incoko, uncumo, ulwaneliseko lokudibanisa imifanekiso emibini, okanye ukuhlala nje nisondelene. Asiyonjongo yethu ukuvavanya nabani na, ukumtyhalela phambili ngokungeyomfuneko, okanye ukungqina nantoni na.

Iiapps ezininzi zokuqeqesha ingqondo zenzelwe isantya, amanqaku, ukulandelelana nempumelelo, kunye namanqanaba. Kumntu ophila nesifo sokulibala (dementia), oko kunokuvakala njengoviwo angasoze alupase. Thina senze okwahlukileyo, kwaye sizibophelele kule migaqo:

  • Akukho nto yokufeyila. Akukho wotshi, manqaku, kubala iintshukumo, bomi bukhuselwayo, kulandelelana nempumelelo, zihombiso zokonwaba okanye ukubala kusehla, kuso nasiphi na isikrini.
  • Ukuqaphela endaweni yokukhumbula entloko. Imifanekiso ihlala ibonakala ngokuzenzekelayo. Imibuzo ivula indlela yencoko kwaye ayivavanyi amagama okanye iinkumbulo.
  • Inkulu, icacile kwaye izinzile. Amagama nemifanekiso emikhulu, imibala eyahluke kakhulu nebonakala lula, kunye nezilawuli ezihlala kwindawo enye.
  • Isidima sabantu abadala. Imifanekiso yobomi bokwenene kunye namagama acacileyo nanobubele. Akukho mifanekiso yoopopayi, ncomo zokuculela abantwana, okanye amabhaso ee-emoji.
  • Indlela elula yokuphuma. Igama elithi “Kwanele okwangoku” lihlala libonakala. Ukuyeka phakathi kusisiphumo esihle.
  • Iyimfihlo ngokwemvelo. Akukho ziiakhawunti okanye zintengiso. Iifoto ozikhethayo zihlala kwisixhobo sakho kuphela.

Izinto esingazibangiyo

Imidlalo yethu yenzelwe ulonwabo nokunxibelelana. Ayixilongi, ayivavanyi, ayilinganisi, ayinyangi, ayicothisi okanye ithintele isifo sokulibala (dementia) okanye isifo se-Alzheimer, kwaye akakho umntu ofanele ayikhethele ezo zizathu. Xa sibhala ngophando kumaphepha ethu empilo yengqondo, sithetha ngokuphandle apho ubungqina bungomelelanga khona, kwaye asibufelele kwaphela kwimidlalo yethu.

Singoobani

IGolden Moments liqela elincinci elizimeleyo. Asingogqirha okanye iingcali zezonyango. Izikhokelo zethu zibhalwe kusetyenziswa izikhokelo ezipapashwe yimibutho efana ne-National Institute on Aging kunye ne-Alzheimer’s Association, kwaye isikhokelo ngasinye sidwelisa apho sifumene khona ulwazi. Funda indlela esiwabhala nesizihlola ngayo amaphepha ethu.

Sixelele into enokunceda

Singathanda ukuva ukuba yintoni ekusebenzelayo nengakusebenzeliyo, ngakumbi kubantu abaphila nesifo sokulibala (dementia), abakhathaleli bentsapho kunye nabasebenzi bemidlalo nemisebenzi. Thumela i-imeyile ku-{email}.

editorial.title: Indlela Esiwabhala Nesizihlola Ngayo Amaphepha Ethu
editorial.description: Indlela iGolden Moments ephanda ngayo, ebhalayo, efumana ngayo ulwazi nokuphucula amaphepha ayo emisebenzi yesifo sokulibala (dementia) nempilo yengqondo, kunye nezinto esingasoze sizipapashe.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Apho sifumana khona ulwazi

Izikhokelo zethu sizisekela kwizikhokelo zoluntu ezivela kwimibutho efana ne-National Institute on Aging, i-CDC, i-Alzheimer’s Association, i-Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, i-Family Caregiver Alliance kunye ne-NHS, nakwiziphumo zophando oluhlolwe ziingcali ezizimeleyo ezifana nohlaziyo lwe-Cochrane novavanyo olukhulu lwezonyango. Isikhokelo ngasinye sibonisa apho sifumene khona ulwazi. Siluvula lonke ulwazi olucaphulweyo ngaphambi kokuba silusebenzise, kwaye sixela kuphela oko kuthethwa lulo ngokwenene.

Indlela esibhala ngayo

  • Izinto eziluncedo kuqala: into onokuyenza namhlanje, ngolwimi olucacileyo nolulula.
  • Ukunyaniseka ngobungqina: sithi “kuyanxulunyaniswa”, “kunokwenzeka” kunye nokuthi “ubungqina buyangqubana” xa iyinyani leyo.
  • Intlonipho: sibhala ngabantu abaphila nesifo sokulibala (dementia) njengabantu abadala, kwaye asisebenzisi lulwimi luvavanyayo okanye oluhlazisayo.
  • Akukho zinto ziqanjiweyo: akukho manani aqanjiweyo, nkcazelo zicaphulweyo, ngcali, zifundo, mbono zophononongo okanye bungqina bobuxoki.

Ngoobani abahlola amaphepha ethu

Amaphepha abhalwa aze ahlolwe liqela le-Golden Moments, ngoncedo lwezixhobo zokubhala ze-AI kuphando nokuyila. Iphepha ngalinye lihlolwa liqela ngokubhekiselele kwimithombo yalo yolwazi. Amaphepha ethu akakhange ahlolwe ngugqirha okanye enye ingcali yezonyango, kwaye asizibangi ukuba ahloliwe. Asiloncebiso lwezonyango, lulwazi jikelele kuphela.

Izinto esingasoze sizipapashe

  • Amabango okuba umdlalo, ukutya, izongezo zesondlo, ukuzila ukutya okanye indlela ethile yokwenza izinto ithintela, inyanga, icothisa okanye iphelisa isifo sokulibala (dementia).
  • Iimvavanyo, imibuzo okanye amanqaku abonisa ukuba umntu unesifo sokulibala (dementia) okanye akanaso.
  • Iingcebiso zokuqala, ukuyeka okanye ukutshintsha nawaphi na amayeza.
  • Iintengiso okanye umxholo oxhasiweyo ngemali ofakwe ngokungathi sisikhokelo.

Uhlaziyo nezilungiso

Iphepha ngalinye libonisa umhla eligqibele ukuhlaziywa ngawo. Ukuba ufumana impazamo okanye umthombo ophelelwe lixesha, nceda uthumele i-imeyile ku-{email} kwaye siza kuyihlola ngokukhawuleza.

faq.title: Imibuzo Neempendulo
faq.seoTitle: Imidlalo Nemisebenzi Yesifo Sokulibala (Dementia): Imibuzo Neempendulo
faq.description: Iimpendulo zemibuzo eqhelekileyo malunga nemidlalo nemisebenzi yesifo sokulibala (dementia): imidlalo onokuyizama, ixesha lokudlala, iingcamango zamanqanaba asemva, impilo yengqondo kunye nemfihlo.
faq.lede: Iimpendulo ezimfutshane nezicacileyo kwimibuzo ehlala ibuzwa ngabakhathaleli.

items.q: Yeyiphi eyona midlalo ilungileyo kumntu ophila nesifo sokulibala (dementia)?
items.a: Oyena mdlalo ubalaseleyo ngulowo uqhelekileyo, olula nongenawo uxinzelelo, kwaye umdlalo ofanelekileyo ngulowo wonwatyelwa ngumntu namhlanje. Ukutshatisa imifanekiso ebonakalayo, ukuhlela izinto, iijigsaw ezilula, ukugqibezela izaci eziqhelekileyo, ukufaka imibala kunye nebhingo yemifanekiso, zonke ezi zisebenza kakuhle kubantu abaninzi. Kuphephe izibali-xesha, amanqaku kunye nayo nantoni na evakala njengoviwo.
Ewe. Yonke imidlalo nezinto eziprintwayo zisimahla, akukho akhawunti, ukubhalisa, ukukhuphela okanye iintengiso.

items.q: Kutheni kungekho manqaku, manqanaba okanye iwotshi ebala ixesha?
items.a: Isantya namanqaku ajika umsebenzi omnandi ube luvavanyo, nto leyo enokuzisa iintloni okanye ukukhathazeka. Sigxila ekonweleni nasekuchitheni ixesha nikunye, ngoko akukho nto yokusilela kwaye ningayeka nanini na.

Nayiphi na ifowuni, ithebhulethi okanye ikhompyutha enebrawuza yewebhu yale mihla. Ithebhulethi emiswe etafileni idla ngokuba yeyona ndlela ilula nekhululekileyo yokuba abantu ababini badlale behleli calanye. Ikhompyutha ephathwayo edityaniswe kumabonakude isebenza kakuhle kumaqela.
Ewe. I-Photo pairs ijika iifoto ezi-2 ukuya kwezi-6 ozikhethayo zibe ngumdlalo wokutshatisa. Iifoto zihlala kwibrawuza yakho kwaye azilayishwa okanye zigcinwe ndawo.

Amaxesha amaninzi imizuzu eyi-10 ukuya kwengama-20 yanele kakhulu, kwaye maxa wambi nemizuzu emi-2 iyimpumelelo. Qaphela iimpawu zokudinwa okanye zokukhathazeka, nize niyeke kusemnandi. Alikho ixesha elimiselweyo ekufuneka libe lilo.

Hlonipha ukwala kwabo, uze uzame kwakhona kamva okanye ngenye indlela. Ukwala kunokubangelwa kukurhaqa, ukuba sezintlungwini, ukungaqiniseki, okanye kukungabi namdla nje ngelo xesha. Jonga isikhokelo sethu malunga nento onokuyenza xa besala.

items.q: Zeziphi izinto zokuzonwabisa ezifanele inqanaba eliphambili ledementia?
items.a: Ukunika intuthuzelo nokuphulula iimvakalelo: ukumamela umculo awuthandayo, ukuphulula izandla ngekhrimu, ukujonga iifoto kunye, ukubamba ingubo ethambileyo, ukuhlala phandle, okanye umdlalo olula kakhulu wemifanekiso ekunye nomntu osecaleni kwakhe. Isikhokelo sethu senqanaba eliphambili sinezimvo ezininzi ezingaphaya.

items.q: Ingaba ikhona imisebenzi yamaqela kwikhaya labakhulileyo?
items.a: Ewe. I-Picture bingo inamakhadi aprintwayo nombizeleli obonakala kwiskrini, kwaye i-Finish the saying namakhadi e-Conversation asebenza kakuhle xa efundelwa phezulu. Isikhokelo sethu samaqela akumakhaya abakhulileyo siquka ubukhulu beqela, ukuhlala nokulungelelanisa izinto ngokwamandla awohlukeneyo abantu.

items.q: Ingaba imidlalo inakho ukuthintela okanye ukucothisa idementia?
items.a: Akukho mdlalo kubonakaliswe ukuba uyayithintela idementia, kwaye imidlalo yethu ayitsho njalo. Ukuvuselela ingqondo kwimeko yobuthelezi kubonakalise iinzuzo ezincinci kuphando kubantu abaphila nedementia ephakathi nendawo, kodwa oko kwahlukile kumdlalo othintela isifo. Sinikezela ngemidlalo ngenjongo yolonwabo nonxibelelwano.

Ayinakuthintelwa ngokuqinisekileyo. Uphando lunxulumanisa izinto ezi-14 zempilo nendlela yokuphila nengcipheko yedementia, ezinjengokungeva kakuhle, uxinzelelo lwegazi oluphezulu, ukungawuvocavoci umzimba nokungadibani nabantu. Ukujongana nezi zinto kunokunciphisa ingcipheko kwabanye abantu, kodwa abantu abaninzi abenza yonke into ngokuchanekileyo basafumana idementia. Asilotyala lamntu konke konke.

items.q: Ingaba ukuzila ukutya okwethutyana kulungile kwimpilo yengqondo?
items.a: Ubungqina obumayela nabantu bunqabile kwaye busaqala, kwaye uninzi lophando lwenziwe kwizilwanyana. Ukuzila ukutya kunokuba yingozi kubantu abadala, ngakumbi kwabo basebenzisa amayeza esifo seswekile okanye abehlelwa bubunzima bengajonganga, kwaye akukhuthazwa kubantu abaphila nedementia. Thetha nogqirha ngaphambi kokuba utshintshe indlela otya ngayo.

Akukho zii-akhawunti okanye iintengiso. Sisebenzisa i-Google Analytics ukubala utyelelo nokubona ukuba ngawaphi amaphepha ancedayo, kwaye ibrawuza yakho iyakhumbula ukuba ingaba uzilayithile izandi ezithambileyo na. Iifoto ozikhethela i-Photo pairs azilayishwa nakanye. Jonga isaziso sobumfihlo ngeenkcukacha ezithe vetshe.
Hayi. I-Golden Moments yeyolonwabo neenkcukacha jikelele. Ngemibuzo yezempilo, thetha nogqirha, kwaye xa kuxakekile tsalela ku-112.

faq.moreHtml: Iinkcukacha ezithe vetshe: indlela yokudlala kunye, xa besala, imisebenzi yenqanaba eliphambili kunye ingaba idementia inokuthintelwa?

handout.title: Imidlalo Esimahla Nethambileyo Yabantu Abaphila neDementia
handout.seoTitle: Iphepha Eliprintwayo: Imidlalo Esimahla yeDementia kwi-Intanethi
handout.description: Iphepha eliprintwayo elinecala elinye leentsapho nabanonopheli elimayela nemidlalo yemifanekiso yasimahla nethambileyo yabantu abaphila nedementia, elilungiselelwe amaqela enkxaso neepakethe zononophelo.
handout.lede: Printa eli phepha ulungiselele iqela lenkxaso, iphakethe lokunonophela okanye ucango lwefriji. Sebenzisa umyalelo wokuprinta webrawuza yakho; iimenyu namaqhosha azibandakanywa kwiphepha eliprintiweyo.
handout.introHtml: Imifanekiso emikhulu, amagama acacileyo kwaye akukho nto yokusilela. Isimahla kwifowuni, ithebhulethi okanye ikhompyutha, akukho kubhalisa, akukho zintengiso, akukho wotshi ibala ixesha kwaye akukho manqaku. Hlalani calanye nize nitshintshisane.
handout.restHtml:
Amacebiso ambalwa

  • Khetha ixesha lemini apho umntu aziva onwabe kakhulu ngalo.
  • Qalisa ngowona mlinganiselo ulula. Iithayile ezine zanele kakhulu.
  • Thethani ngemifanekiso. Incoko idla ngokuba yeyona nxalenye emnandi kakhulu.
  • Yekani kusemnandi. Ukugqiba kwangethuba kusisiphumo esihle.

Kukwakho noku kule sayithi

  • Izinto ezishicilelwayo ezisimahla: amagama afunwayo anamagama amakhulu, amaphepha okufaka imibala, amakhadi encoko kunye ne-picture bingo.
  • Izimvo zemisebenzi yenqanaba ngalinye, nezikhokelo zokudlala kunye nokuzikhathalela wena ngokwakho.

Yeyolonwabo nokuchitha ixesha nikunye. Asingomacebiso ezonyango, uvavanyo okanye unyango. I-Golden Moments ipapashwe yi-Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.title: Yenzelwe Amakhaya Abakhulileyo, Amathala Eencwadi Namaqela Enkxaso
organizations.seoTitle: Imisebenzi Yasimahla Yabaphila Nesifo Sokulibala Yamakhaya Okhathalelo Namaqela
organizations.description: Indlela amakhaya okhathalelo, iinkqubo zasemini zabadala, amathala eencwadi, ii-arhente zabakhulileyo namaqela enkxaso abasebenzisa ngayo imidlalo yethu yasimahla yabaphila nesifo sokulibala, kunye namagama onokuwasebenzisa ukusidibanisa kuluhlu lwezixhobo zoncedo.
organizations.lede: Yonke into ekule sayithi isimahla ukuba ingasetyenziswa nabahlali, amalungu kunye nabaxhamli benkonzo, ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti, ilayisensi okanye intlawulo. Eli phepha lichaza oko kufumanekayo apha nendlela yokwabelana ngako.
organizations.shortText: {name}: imidlalo yemifanekiso epholileyo nesimahla nezikhokelo zemisebenzi yabantu abaphila nesifo sokulibala kunye nabanonopheli babo. Akukho kubhalisa, akukho zibali-xesha, akukho manqaku.
organizations.longText: {name} ({domain}) ibonelela ngemidlalo yasimahla ye-bhrawuza eyi-{count} eyenzelwe abantu abaphila nesifo sokulibala, equka ukutshatisa izibini enemifanekiso ehlala ibonakala, iphazili yeejigsaw elula, ukuhlela, izaci eziqhelekileyo kunye nebhingo yemifanekiso enamakhadi ashicilelekayo. Akukho akhawunti, zintengiso, zibali-xesha okanye manqaku. Le sayithi ikwanazo nezikhokelo zemisebenzi ezibhalwe ngolwimi olucacileyo lwenqanaba ngalinye lesifo sokulibala ezicaphula iNational Institute on Aging kunye ne-Alzheimer's Association.
organizations.gamesItemHtml: Imidlalo ye-bhrawuza eyi-{count} esebenza kwilaptop, ithebhulethi okanye i-TV eqhagamshelwe kwikhompyutha. Akukho kufakela, akhawunti okanye kukhuphela. Bona yonke imidlalo.
organizations.printablesAfter: Sebenzisa iqhosha elithi Shicilela kwiphepha ngalinye.
organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Iindlela zamaqela: Ibhingo yemifanekiso inamakhadi ashicilelekayo nombizi wesikrini, kwaye imibuzo elula inemibuzo engama-50 eneempendulo onokukhetha kuzo nezihloko zokuncokola.
  • Izikhokelo zemisebenzi zabasebenzi neentsapho, ngokwamanqanaba nangokweentlobo, ezibhalwe ngolwimi olulula nezinezalathiso. Qala nge-zimvo zemisebenzi ezili-101 okanye group activities for care homes.
organizations.restHtml:
Indlela amaqela ayisebenzisa ngayo

  • Amakhaya okhathalelo nokhathalelo lwenkumbulo: ibhingo yemifanekiso okanye gqibezela-isaci kwi-TV yegumbi eliqhelekileyo, ngomntu omnye ocofa iqhosha egameni leqela.
  • Iinkqubo zasemini zabadala: indawo yethebhulethi eneZibini zeMifanekiso emiswe kumathayili amane, kulungiselelwa amaxesha amafutshane omntu nomntu.
  • Amathala eencwadi oluntu: amaphepha ashicilelweyo okukhangela amagama namakhadi encoko kwiikiti zenkumbulo, kwaye isayithi ibekwe kwizinto ezigciniweyo kwiithebhulethi zethala leencwadi.
  • Amaqela enkxaso yabanonopheli nee-memory café: iphepha elinye elishicilelekayo lokuba iintsapho ligoduke nalo.
  • Izibhedlele nabacwangcisi bokukhululwa kwabagula: elo phepha lifakwa kwiipakethi zabanonopheli, ukunika into epholileyo enokwenziwa ekhaya okanye ecaleni kwebhedi.

Into esingayenziyo

Le midlalo yenzelwe ukonwaba nokuchitha ixesha kunye. Ayixilongi, ayivavanyi, ayiniki manqaku, ayinyangi kwaye ayilicothisi isifo sokulibala, kwaye sicela imibutho ukuba ingayichazi ngaloo ndlela. Akukho ntengiso, kwaye le midlalo ayibizi magama, iinkcukacha zempilo okanye ukufakwa kweefoto. Le webhusayithi isebenzisa iGoogle Analytics ukubala utyelelo; isaziso sethu sabucala sicacisa oko kuqokelelwayo. Iifoto ezisetyenziswa kwi-Photo pairs zihlala kwi-bhrawuza kuphela.

Sidibanise kuluhlu lwakho lwezixhobo zoncedo

Ukuba unoluhlu lwezixhobo zoncedo lwabanonopheli, wamkelekile ukudibanisa ikhonkco le-{domain}. Ungakhuphela nayiphi na inkcazo kwezi zimbini.
organizations.linksHtml:
Amaphepha aluncedo onokudibanisa kuwo ngokuthe ngqo: imidlalo yasimahla, amaphepha ashicilelekayo asimahla, imisebenzi yelwe-Alzheimer kunye ne-ndlela yokudlala kunye.

Imibuzo okanye izilungiso

Ukuba kukho into ephosakeleyo okanye engacacanga kule sayithi, okanye iimfuno zomhlali azifezekiswa koko kukhoyo apha, nceda usixelele ku-{email}. Nceda ungathumeli nkcukacha zomntu okanye zempilo zabahlali okanye zabaxhamli benkonzo.

app.title: I-App ye-Golden Moments
app.description: I-app yasimahla ye-Golden Moments: ukutshatisa iifoto ngokuzolileyo ngamathayili amane amakhulu, iifoto zentsapho ezigcinwa kwisixhobo sakho, iipakethi zemifanekiso ngaphandle kwe-intanethi kwaye akukho akhawunti.
app.lede: Yonke into oyithandayo ngewebhusayithi, kwi-app esebenza nangaphandle kwe-intanethi kwaye enokusebenzisa iifoto zentsapho ozikhethelayo.
app.bodyHtml:
Qala kancinci

Qala ngamakhadi amane amakhulu nemifanekiso eqhelekileyo. Yiyeke imifanekiso ibonakale, okanye yifihle xa uziva ukhululekile ngolo hlobo. Imo ezolileyo ayinamlinganiseli-xesha, manqaku okanye sohlwayo. Khetha amakhadi ama-4, ama-6, asi-8 okanye ali-12.

Yenze ibe yeyakho neyosapho

Khetha iifoto zosapho usebenzisa isikhethi-foto sesixhobo sakho. I-aphu igcina iikopi ezincinci zokusetyenziswa kwimisebenzi yayo. Ayiphengululi ifoto-layibrari yakho kwaye ayizitshintshi iifoto zakho zantlandlolo, kwaye igcina ukuya kutsho kwiifoto ezingama-24 kwingqokelela nganye.

Jongani kunye nje kuphela

Jongani umfanekiso omnye ngexesha. Imibuzo neengcinga onokuzikhetha zivula incoko ngaphandle kokunyanzela nabani na ukuba akhumbule amagama okanye anike impendulo echanekileyo. Ukujonga nje kuphela kwanele.

Isebenza ngaphandle kwe-intanethi apho kufunekayo

Imifanekiso yokuqala kunye nazo zonke iipakethi zemifanekiso ezisi-8 ziza zikuyo le aphu. Iikopi zeefoto ozifakileyo zisebenza ngaphandle kwe-intanethi. Ukukhetha iifoto zantlandlolo ezigcinwe kuphela kwi-iCloud kungafuna uqhagamshelo lwe-intanethi.

Akukho akhawunti, akukho mncedisi wokungqamanisa iifoto

Iikopi zeefoto zosapho zihlala kule aphu kwesi sixhobo. Ungazisusa iikopi ngaphandle kokucima iifoto zantlandlolo. Iikopi zokugcina zesixhobo zingaquka idatha yale aphu. Funda umgaqo-nkqubo wokukhusela iinkcukacha ze-aphu, kwaye uncedo lwe-aphu luhamba nawe kwinyathelo ngalinye.
app.disclaimer: I-Golden Moments yenzelwe ukuzonwabisa kunye nokuncokola kunye. Ayixilongi, ayinyangi, ayithinteli kwaye ayilinganisi isifo sokulibala (idementia) okanye isifo se-Alzheimer.

gamesIndex.title: Imidlalo Yasimahla ye-Intanethi Yabaphila neDementia ne-Alzheimer
gamesIndex.description: Imidlalo yasimahla ye-intanethi yabantu abadala abaphila nesifo sokulibala (idementia) okanye i-Alzheimer: ukutshatisa imifanekiso, iijigsaw ezilula, ukuhlela, izaci namaqhalo, ukufaka imibala, nebhingo. Akukho kubhalisa, zibali-xesha okanye manqaku.
gamesIndex.lede: Imidlalo yasimahla eyi-{count} yokudlala kunye kwibhrawuza yakho. Imifanekiso emikhulu, amagama acacileyo, kwaye akukho nto yokoyisa okanye ukutsiba: akukho zibali-xesha, akukho manqaku, akukho kubhalisa.
gamesIndex.byStageLede: Amanqanaba asisikhokelo nje gabalala. Landela oko umntu akunikiweyo noko kumvuyisayo kwaye kukhululekile kuye namhlanje.
gamesIndex.moreHtml: Ezinye iingcamango ezingaphandle kwesikrini: imisebenzi eyi-101 yabantu abaphila nedementia, imisebenzi nemidlalo ye-Alzheimer, imidlalo yengqondo ezolileyo kunye neziphicaphicwano.

faq.a: Ukutshatisa izibini zemifanekiso ngamakhadi amane lukhetho lokuqala oluzolileyo. Ukuba ukukhetha phakathi kwemifanekiso kuvakala kuxakekisa kakhulu, zama Fumana efanayo enemifanekiso emibini. Kwigqiza okanye iqela, zama Ibhingo yemifanekiso.

faq.q: Ingaba le midlalo iyasebenza kwi-iPad okanye kwifowuni?
faq.a: Ewe. Umdlalo ngamnye usebenza kwibhrawuza kwiifowuni, iitafileti nakwiikhompyutha, kwaye imifanekiso iyanda ukuze izalise isikrini. Ithebhulethi ebekwe kwisixhasi idla ngokuba yeyona ikhululekileyo kubantu ababini.

faq.q: Ingaba le midlalo ilungile kumntu ophila ne-Alzheimer?
faq.a: Ewe. Yenzelwe abantu abaphila nesifo sokulibala (idementia), kuquka ne-Alzheimer, eyona mbangeli ixhaphakileyo. Imifanekiso ihlala ibonakala, mancinci amathuba okukhetha, kwaye akukho nto ibalelwa ixesha okanye inikwe amanqaku, ngoko ke imidlalo ixhomekeke ekuboneni izinto eziqhelekileyo kunokuba kukhunjulwe izinto ezintsha.

faq.q: Ingaba le yimidlalo yengqondo yabantu abadala?
faq.a: Yimidlalo yokutshatisa neyemifanekiso enokonwatyelwa nguye nawuphi na umntu omdala, kodwa yakhelwe ukuba ingavavanyi inkumbulo: kuTshatisa izibini zemifanekiso, imifanekiso ihlala ijongise phezulu ngaphandle kokuba ukhethe ngenye indlela. Isikhokelo sethu semidlalo yenkumbulo yabantu abadala abaphila nedementia sicacisa indlela yokwenza nawuphi na umdlalo wenkumbulo ube nozolo.

faq.q: Ingaba ikhona imidlalo yamaqela kwikhaya labakhulileyo nabalupheleyo?
faq.a: Ewe. Ibhingo yemifanekiso inamakhadi anokuprintwa kunye nombizi okwisikrini, kwaye Gqibezela isaci kunye namakhadi eNcoko asebenza kakuhle xa efundelwa phezulu kwiqela.
